note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The context is the room after the filing: folder A (the original file with a placeholder decision sheet) and folder B (the new pieces) on either side of a neutral divider. One supplied datum is substituted on piece X's record plate — its mark, from original material to proposed additional material; the old value is kept in the dock as 'was'; only the dependent geometry follows (X's strip and the folder it lies in). Nothing is assessed: no admissibility rule, validity, time limit, outcome or jurisdiction. Brief fields: decisions, grounds, routes, outcomes, focusTarget, beforeValue, afterValue, detailGeometry and contextLabels are editable.
